mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 0.3% in the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher corporate profit expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% in the current month
failure_condition: Across 12 consecutive months with PAYEMS > 0.5% increase, 20-day forward returns show no consistent outperformance (median negative).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO supply index below 100 suggests softening manufacturing capacity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 100 observations, the signal (INDPRO < 100) is never followed by a statistically significant negative 5-day forward return (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly drop in both GDPC1 and HOUST retail sales, each below -2%, indicates weakening demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < -2 AND HOUST < -2 in the current month
failure_condition: In 50 such double-demand shock events, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (median ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Across 10 such episodes, 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for three months is expected to depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 15 such regimes, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (median ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in RSAFS demand index below 700,000 coinciding with INDPRO < 100, signals a supply-side recession, predicting negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 700000 AND INDPRO < 100 in the same month
failure_condition: Over 30 such events, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (median ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 3.5% for 4 consecutive months), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 days due to higher growth expectations.
failure_condition: In 20 such regimes, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (median ≤ 0).
